Null Values and Misclassified Data Types

Be especially careful with null values and checking data types. Nulls can skew calculations like averages or medians, and misclassified data types — such as dates stored as integers — can lead to errors in analysis.
Always verify that each column has the correct and consistent data type before building your visualizations.
